name: Gain on insurance claims
description: Gain arising when insurance proceeds received exceed the carrying amount of the related loss.
description@ja_JP: 受け取った保険金が、対応する損失の帳簿価額を上回ったことにより生じた利益。

name: Gain on forgiveness of debts
description: Gain recognized when a creditor forgives a debt owed by the company.
description@ja_JP: 債権者から債務の免除を受けたことにより生じた利益。

name: Cost of sales
description: Direct costs of goods or services sold during the period.
description@ja_JP: 当期に販売した商品又はサービスに直接対応する原価。

name: Beginning merchandise inventory
description: Value of merchandise inventory on hand at the beginning of the period.
description@ja_JP: 期首時点で保有していた商品棚卸高。

name: Purchase of goods
description: Total cost of merchandise purchased during the period.
description@ja_JP: 当期中に仕入れた商品の総額。

name: Purchase allowance and returns
description: Reductions in purchase cost from price allowances and goods returned to suppliers.
description@ja_JP: 仕入値引及び仕入先への返品による仕入原価の減少額。

name: Ending merchandise inventory
description: Value of merchandise inventory on hand at the end of the period.
description@ja_JP: 期末時点で保有している商品棚卸高。

name: Beginning finished goods inventory
description: Value of finished goods inventory on hand at the beginning of the period.
description@ja_JP: 期首時点で保有していた製品棚卸高。

name: Cost of products manufactured
description: Total manufacturing cost of products completed during the period.
description@ja_JP: 当期に完成した製品の製造原価の合計額。

name: Ending finished goods inventory
description: Value of finished goods inventory on hand at the end of the period.
description@ja_JP: 期末時点で保有している製品棚卸高。

name: Outsourcing expenses
description: Costs paid to external parties for outsourced work or services.
description@ja_JP: 外部に委託した作業又はサービスに対して支払った費用。

name: Sales commission
description: Commissions paid to agents or salespeople for sales generated.
description@ja_JP: 販売により生じた、代理店や販売員への手数料。

name: Packing expenses
description: Costs of packing and preparing goods for shipment.
description@ja_JP: 商品の発送準備のための荷造りに要した費用。

name: Transportation costs
description: Costs of transporting goods to customers or between locations.
description@ja_JP: 商品を顧客又は事業所間で輸送するために要した費用。

name: Advertising expenses
description: Costs incurred for advertising and promoting the company's products or services.
description@ja_JP: 会社の商品又はサービスの広告及び宣伝のために支出した費用。

name: Sample expenses
description: Costs of producing or providing product samples.
description@ja_JP: 商品サンプルの製作又は提供に要した費用。

name: Remuneration for directors (and other officers)
description: Compensation and bonus paid to directors and other officers of the company.
description@ja_JP: 取締役その他役員に支払う報酬・賞与。

name: Welfare expenses
description: Costs of employee welfare benefits such as events and amenities.
description@ja_JP: 社内行事や福利施設など、従業員の福利厚生のために要した費用。

name: Entertainment expenses
description: Costs of entertaining clients and business partners.
description@ja_JP: 得意先や取引先を接待するために要した費用。

name: Communication expenses
description: Costs of telephone, internet, postage, and other communication services.
description@ja_JP: 電話、インターネット、郵便その他通信サービスに要した費用。

name: Supplies expenses
description: Costs of consumable supplies used in business operations.
description@ja_JP: 事業活動で使用する消耗品に要した費用。

name: Taxes and dues
description: Taxes and public dues other than income taxes related to business operations, such as property and stamp taxes.
description@ja_JP: 事業に関連する法人税等以外の税金及び公的な負担金で、固定資産税や印紙税など。

name: Depreciation
description: Periodic depreciation expense for tangible and intangible fixed assets used in business operations.
description@ja_JP: 事業活動で使用する有形及び無形固定資産に対する各期の減価償却費。

name: Repair expenses
description: Costs of repairing and maintaining property and equipment.
description@ja_JP: 固定資産の修繕及び維持に要した費用。

name: Insurance expenses
description: Insurance premiums paid for business-related coverage.
description@ja_JP: 事業に関連して支払った保険料。

name: Provision of allowance for doubtful accounts
description: Expense recognized for additions to the allowance for doubtful trade receivables.
description@ja_JP: 営業債権(売掛金等)に対する貸倒引当金の積み増しに伴って計上する費用。

name: Research and development expenses
description: Costs incurred for research and development activities.
description@ja_JP: 研究開発活動のために支出した費用。

name: Employees' salaries
description: Wages and salaries paid to employees.
description@ja_JP: 従業員に支払う給料及び賃金。

name: Employees' bonuses
description: Bonuses paid to employees.
description@ja_JP: 従業員に支給する賞与。

name: Retirement payments
description: Retirement payments made to employees.
description@ja_JP: 従業員に支給する退職金。

name: Retirement benefits for directors (and other officers)
description: Retirement benefits paid to directors and other officers.
description@ja_JP: 取締役その他役員に支払う退職慰労金。

name: Legal welfare expenses
description: Statutory social insurance contributions borne by the company, such as health and pension insurance.
description@ja_JP: 健康保険及び厚生年金保険など、会社が負担する法定の社会保険料。

name: Amortization of goodwill
description: Periodic amortization expense for goodwill recognized in a business combination.
description@ja_JP: 企業結合により認識したのれんに対する各期の償却費。

name: Amortization of business commencement expenses
description: Amortization of capitalized business commencement expenses, classified under selling, general and administrative expenses.
description@ja_JP: 繰延資産として計上した開業費の当期償却額（販管費）。

name: Amortization of development expenses
description: Amortization of capitalized development expenses, classified under selling, general and administrative expenses.
description@ja_JP: 繰延資産として計上した開発費の当期償却額（販管費）。

name: Fee expenses
description: Fees paid for professional or other outside services.
description@ja_JP: 専門家その他の外部サービスに対して支払う報酬。

name: Training expenses
description: Costs of employee training and development programs.
description@ja_JP: 従業員の研修及び育成プログラムに要した費用。

name: Rent expenses
description: Rent paid for the use of equipment or other assets.
description@ja_JP: 設備その他の資産の使用のために支払う賃借料。

name: Rent expenses on land and buildings
description: Rent paid for the use of land and buildings.
description@ja_JP: 土地及び建物の使用のために支払う地代及び家賃。

name: Promotion expenses
description: Costs incurred to promote sales of products or services.
description@ja_JP: 商品又はサービスの販売を促進するために支出した費用。

name: Transportation and storage costs
description: Costs of transporting and storing goods.
description@ja_JP: 商品の運送及び保管に要した費用。

name: Utilities expenses
description: Costs of electricity, gas, and water used in operations.
description@ja_JP: 事業活動で使用する電気、ガス及び水道に要した費用。

name: Medical expenses
description: Costs related to employee health and sanitation.
description@ja_JP: 従業員の健康及び衛生管理に関連する費用。

name: Office supplies expenses
description: Costs of office supplies used in administrative operations.
description@ja_JP: 事務作業で使用する消耗品に要した費用。

name: Vehicle expenses
description: Costs of operating and maintaining company vehicles.
description@ja_JP: 会社の車両の運行及び維持に要した費用。

name: Meeting expenses
description: Costs incurred for holding business meetings.
description@ja_JP: 業務上の会議の開催に要した費用。

name: Membership fee
description: Membership dues paid to associations and organizations.
description@ja_JP: 各種団体や組織に支払う会費。

name: Book expenses
description: Costs of books, newspapers, and other publications.
description@ja_JP: 書籍、新聞その他出版物の購入に要した費用。

name: Travel and transportation expenses
description: Costs of business travel and local transportation.
description@ja_JP: 出張その他業務上の移動に要した旅費及び交通費。

name: Miscellaneous expenses
description: Other minor operating expenses not separately classified.
description@ja_JP: 他のいずれの区分にも該当しない、その他の営業費用。

name: Other general and administrative expenses
description: Other general and administrative expenses not separately classified.
description@ja_JP: 他のいずれの区分にも該当しない、その他の一般管理費。

name: Interest expenses
description: Interest incurred on borrowings and other interest-bearing liabilities.
description@ja_JP: 借入金その他有利子負債に対して発生する利息。

name: Sales discounts
description: Discounts given to customers for early payment of receivables.
description@ja_JP: 代金を早期に回収したことにより顧客に与える割引。

name: Loss on sales of securities
description: Losses realized on the sale of securities.
description@ja_JP: 有価証券の売却により生じた損失。

name: Loss on valuation of securities
description: Unrealized losses from the revaluation of securities.
description@ja_JP: 有価証券を時価評価したことにより生じた未実現の評価損。

name: Amortization of bond issuance cost
description: Amortization of capitalized bond issuance costs, classified under non-operating expenses.
description@ja_JP: 繰延資産として計上した社債発行費の当期償却額。

name: Amortization of share acquisition rights issuance cost
description: Amortization of capitalized share acquisition rights issuance costs, classified under non-operating expenses.
name@ja_JP: 新株予約権発行費償却
description@ja_JP: 繰延資産として計上した新株予約権発行費の当期償却額。

name: Amortization of share issuance cost
description: Amortization of capitalized share issuance costs, classified under non-operating expenses.
description@ja_JP: 繰延資産として計上した株式交付費の当期償却額。

name: Foreign exchange losses
description: Losses arising from fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates.
description@ja_JP: 外国為替レートの変動により生じた損失。

name: Loss on sales of notes receivable - trade
description: Losses incurred on the sale or discounting of trade notes receivable.
description@ja_JP: 受取手形の譲渡又は割引により生じた損失。

name: Depreciation
description: Periodic depreciation expense for tangible and intangible fixed assets.
description@ja_JP: 有形及び無形固定資産に対する各期の減価償却費。

name: Loss on sales of non-current assets
description: Losses realized on the sale of non-current assets.
description@ja_JP: 固定資産の売却により生じた損失。

name: Loss on retirement of non-current assets
description: Losses incurred on the disposal or scrapping of non-current assets.
description@ja_JP: 固定資産の除却又は廃棄により生じた損失。

name: Loss on valuation of non-current assets
description: Losses from the write-down of non-current assets to their recoverable amount.
description@ja_JP: 固定資産を回収可能価額まで減額したことにより生じた損失。

name: Loss on valuation of inventories
description: Losses from the write-down of inventories to their net realizable value.
description@ja_JP: 棚卸資産を正味売却価額まで減額したことにより生じた損失。

name: Provision of allowance for doubtful accounts
description: Expense recognized for additions to the allowance for doubtful accounts.
description@ja_JP: 貸倒引当金の積み増しに伴って計上する費用。

name: Bad debts expenses
description: Losses from receivables determined to be uncollectible.
description@ja_JP: 回収不能と判断された債権に係る損失。

name: Amortization of organization expenses
description: Periodic amortization expense for capitalized business organization costs.
description@ja_JP: 資産計上した会社設立に係る費用の各期の償却額。

name: Amortization of long-term prepaid expenses
description: Periodic amortization expense for long-term prepaid expenses.
description@ja_JP: 長期前払費用に対する各期の償却額。

name: Commission expenses
description: Fees and commissions paid for services received.
description@ja_JP: 受けたサービスに対して支払う手数料。

name: Taxes and dues
description: Taxes and public dues other than income taxes, such as property and stamp taxes.
description@ja_JP: 法人税等以外の税金及び公的な負担金で、固定資産税や印紙税など。

name: Donations
description: Charitable and other donations made by the company.
description@ja_JP: 会社が行う寄付その他の慈善的な支出。

name: Miscellaneous loss
description: Other minor non-operating losses not separately classified.
description@ja_JP: 他のいずれの区分にも該当しない、その他の営業外損失。

name: Loss on disaster
description: Losses incurred as a result of natural disasters or other casualty events.
description@ja_JP: 自然災害その他の災害事故により生じた損失。

name: Income taxes
description: Subtotal of corporate, resident, and enterprise income taxes.
description@ja_JP: 法人税、住民税及び事業税の合計を示す小計。

name: Income taxes - current
description: Corporate, resident, and enterprise taxes for the current period.
name@ja_JP: 法人税、住民税及び事業税
description@ja_JP: 当期に帰属する法人税、住民税及び事業税。

name: Income taxes - deferred
description: Adjustment to income taxes for changes in deferred tax assets and liabilities.
description@ja_JP: 繰延税金資産及び繰延税金負債の変動に伴う法人税等の調整額。

name: Patent right
description: The exclusive right to work an invention registered under the Patent Act.
description@ja_JP: 特許法に基づき登録された発明を独占的に実施できる権利。

name: Design right
description: The exclusive right to use a design registered under the Design Act.
description@ja_JP: 意匠法に基づき登録された物品等のデザインを独占的に実施できる権利。

name: Utility model right
description: The exclusive right to work a device registered under the Utility Model Act.
description@ja_JP: 実用新案法に基づき登録された考案を独占的に実施できる権利。

name: Trademark right
description: The exclusive right to use a trademark registered under the Trademark Act.
description@ja_JP: 商標法に基づき登録された商標を独占的に使用できる権利。

name: Advance payment of consumption tax
description: Consumption tax paid as an interim/advance payment during the fiscal year, to be offset against the final tax liability determined at year-end settlement. Tracked separately from consumption tax receivable on purchases (10A101151).
description@ja_JP: 消費税の中間申告により納付した金額で、確定申告時に確定する消費税額と相殺されるもの。仕入に係る仮払消費税等（10A101151）とは区分して管理する。

name: Consumption tax refund receivable
description: Net consumption tax refundable from the tax authority, determined by offsetting consumption tax receivable and payable at period-end closing.
description@ja_JP: 仮払消費税等・仮受消費税等を相殺した結果、税務署から還付を受ける消費税の精算額。

name: Consumption tax payable
description: Net consumption tax payable to the tax authority, determined by offsetting consumption tax receivable and payable at period-end closing.
description@ja_JP: 仮払消費税等・仮受消費税等を相殺した結果、税務署に納付すべき消費税の精算額。
